svg.title: Minor seventh versus major seventh (phone)
svg.desc: Minor seventh versus major seventh. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with C4 as the shared root and the upper notes B♭4 (m7, 10 semitones), B4 (M7, 11 semitones) each in its own identity colour. A table lists what stayed (root C4) and what changed (upper note, semitone count, and the Plogger shape, shadow and fill where they apply).

g.text: C4 to B♭4 (10) and C4 to B4 (11). C4 to B4
is 11; B4 to C5 is a separate step of 1.
m7 → M7: +1 semitone on the upper note
